title: Finance repro
summary: Financial analyst with six years of experience building forecasting models, managing month-end close, and partnering with operations to improve margin. Skilled at translating large datasets into board-ready reporting, automating recurring reconciliations, and tightening internal controls across multi-entity structures. Comfortable owning the full reporting cycle from raw ledgers through variance analysis and commentary for senior leadership.

experience.summary: Own the quarterly forecast and monthly management reporting pack for a portfolio of eleven operating entities, presenting results and variance commentary directly to the CFO and audit committee.
bullets: Rebuilt the rolling twelve-month forecast in Power BI and SQL, cutting the reporting cycle from nine days to three and eliminating manual spreadsheet reconciliation.
Introduced a driver-based margin model that surfaced 4.2m of recoverable cost across procurement and logistics, adopted by the group finance function.
Led the migration of statutory reporting to a consolidated IFRS basis, coordinating external auditors and closing eleven legacy control gaps.

experience.summary: Supported budgeting, cost accounting, and commercial analysis for a retail network of 140 stores.
bullets: Automated the weekly store-level flash report, replacing a manual process and freeing two days of analyst time each week.
Partnered with category managers to model promotional ROI, improving contribution margin on the top forty SKUs by 180 basis points.

projects.name: Group Consolidation Dashboard
projects.description: A single reporting layer consolidating eleven entities with automated eliminations, drill-through to journal level, and a board pack exported on demand.
highlights: Reduced consolidation time from five days to under one, with a full audit trail for every adjustment.

projects.name: Working Capital Optimisation
projects.description: Cash-conversion model that identified payment-terms and inventory opportunities across the supply chain.
highlights: Released 6.8m of working capital within two quarters through negotiated terms and demand-based replenishment.
